tools.description: Returns the current version and vault path configuration for symdesk.
tools.name: desk_status

tools.description: Lists files in the vault.
tools.name: desk_ls

tools.description: Searches notes with full-text terms plus path:, tag:, type:, status:, filename:, filetype:, created:, modified:, quoted phrases, -negation and /regex/. Filetype accepts comma-separated extensions (for example pdf,epub); dates accept YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD and last day/week/month/year. Invalid syntax falls back to plain full-text and returns a hint.
tools.name: desk_search

tools.description: Answers "what happened on day X": returns journal activity from the vault (daily NDJSON journal) plus indexed documents whose document date or modification time falls in the given range. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; from and to default to today.
tools.name: vault_timeline

tools.description: Gets properties (frontmatter) for a note.
tools.name: desk_props

tools.description: Gets backlinks for a note.
tools.name: desk_backlinks

tools.description: Asks the AI a question about the vault. Uses a local Ollama instance when configured; otherwise returns the top search results with a note that AI is not configured. The answer is returned as one aggregated text (no streaming). Pass notebook to restrict retrieval and citations to that notebook's sources instead of the whole vault.

notebook.description: optional: notebook id or path to restrict retrieval and citations to

tools.name: desk_ask

tools.description: Transforms the given text with a local AI action. intent is one of summarize, rewrite or continue. Uses a local Ollama instance when configured; otherwise returns a note that AI is not configured. The result is returned as one aggregated text (no streaming).
tools.name: desk_transform

tools.description: Lists indexed documents with optional filters (status, person, correspondent, type, year, due-before, min/max confidence). Returns structured document metadata.
tools.name: desk_docs

tools.description: Returns documents needing review: confidence below threshold or missing document_type/document_date.
tools.name: docs_review

tools.description: Finds near-duplicate documents using SimHash similarity. Returns documents with similarity >= threshold.
tools.name: docs_similar

tools.description: Scans the Markdown vault for parse errors, missing frontmatter, broken wikilinks and near-duplicate documents, returning a reviewable repair plan without changing files.
tools.name: vault_health

tools.description: Gets related entities and notes for a given file path based on composition with symmemory.
tools.name: desk_related

tools.description: Renders the vault link graph as an SVG diagram. Returns the SVG document; use it to embed or display the vault's structure.
tools.name: desk_diagram

tools.description: Lists ingestion jobs in the queue from symingest.
tools.name: desk_ingest_jobs

tools.description: Lists the configured document classification rules. Legacy alias: list_rules.
tools.name: desk_rules_list

tools.description: Lists meetings already imported into the vault as reviewed meeting notes.
tools.name: meeting_list

tools.description: Gets one imported meeting note by its vault-relative path, including the reviewed transcript.
tools.name: meeting_get

tools.description: Reads the full output of an externalized tool result by its handle (returned as "[Full result externalized to <handle>…]"). Use this to re-read a result that was summarized because it was large.

handle.description: the externalized-result handle from the tool output

tools.name: desk_read_result

tools.description: Lists all notebooks in the vault. A notebook is a named, bounded set of vault sources used to scope AI grounding, retrieval and generated artifacts.
tools.name: notebook_list

tools.description: Gets one notebook by id or vault-relative path, including its resolved sources (path, current title, and whether the source file still exists).
tools.name: notebook_get

tools.description: Asks the AI a question restricted to one notebook's sources: retrieval and citations never leave the notebook's scope. Uses a local Ollama instance when configured; otherwise returns a note that AI is not configured. The answer is returned as one aggregated text (no streaming).
tools.name: notebook_ask

tools.description: Lists Markdown-backed datasets and their materialized row counts.
tools.name: desk_dataset_list

tools.description: Describes one Markdown-backed dataset, including schema, provenance, coverage and row count.
tools.name: desk_dataset_describe

tools.description: Queries a dataset with selected columns, existing view filter operators, grouping and bounded sum/count/min/max/average aggregates. Raw SQL is not accepted.
tools.name: desk_dataset_query

tools.description: Lists ingestion jobs in the queue. Legacy alias for desk_ingest_jobs.
tools.name: list_jobs

tools.description: Lists indexed documents with optional filters (status, person, correspondent, type, year, due-before, min/max confidence). Legacy alias for desk_docs.
tools.name: list_documents

tools.description: Searches notes with full-text terms plus path:, tag:, type:, status:, filename:, filetype:, created:, modified:, quoted phrases, -negation and /regex/. Filetype accepts comma-separated extensions (for example pdf,epub); dates accept YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD and last day/week/month/year. Invalid syntax falls back to plain full-text and returns a hint. Legacy alias for desk_search.
tools.name: search_documents

tools.description: Lists the configured document classification rules. Legacy alias for desk_rules_list.
tools.name: list_rules
